## Checklist

- [ ] Opened an issue first (for behavior changes, new tooling, or larger features)
- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes (tests + doctests, 100% coverage)
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format .` are clean
- [ ] `uv run ty check` passes
- [ ] Docs updated where relevant (`README.md`, `examples/`, `AGENTS.md`)
- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] No secrets (tokens) included in the diff or logs
